title: SandyChic 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the state-of-the-art kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and extensive countertop space, making meal preparation a delight. The kitchen also features bar stool seating for four, complemented by a stylish dining area that seats ten. A screened-in porch adds a peaceful retreat, ideal for any time of day. The sleeping arrangements include sumptuous king-sized beds in the guest and master bedrooms, the latter of which opens onto a private balcony with breathtaking preserved views. The master suite also features a decadent soaking tub and walk-in shower. For additional fun and relaxation, the loft area is equipped with cozy bean bags and a TV, perfect for entertainment or a quiet escape. Oak Circle Oasis not only promises a comfortable stay but also an experience of pure relaxation and connection with the beauty of nature. Nestled in the serene enclave of Watercolor, Florida, Oak Circle Oasis offers a perfect blend of elegance and natural beauty, with its stunning views of the nearby preserve visible from multiple outdoor spaces. This home has been meticulously designed with attention to every detail, from the charming porch swing to the exquisite artwork adorning the walls. The residence boasts four elegantly appointed bedrooms, a versatile loft space, and four-and-a-half bathrooms, accommodating up to 12 guests. The inviting front porch, complete with a swing, offers a tranquil spot for morning coffees or leisurely naps, while the main living area provides an open, airy environment for guests to connect and relax.
